events.title: Update 0.0.25
events.summary: Update 0.0.25- Fixed an issue with End Stage Screen not being centered on some resolutions.- Potential Fix for Hang/Crashes.- Added Launch Options / Vulkan / DirectX12 / OpenGL.- Fixed Movement Speed Skill Description.- Fixed an issue with Background Image in Main Menu when skipping intro.

events.title: Update 0.0.24
events.summary: Update 0.0.24Known Issues:There are issues with setting up resolution, workaround is to close game, restart and do it from main menu.Crash & hangs issues, still looking into it more, let me know if you find and reproduce them!- Improved the Sword Animation.- Improved the Sound Effect of Sword Animation.- Added Sound effects for Roll and Blink.- Replaced Projectile Casting Sound for Monsters.- Lowered Projectile Hit on ground sound.- Added Hit Sound effect to the Melee Attacks of Second Monster,

events.title: Update 0.0.23
events.summary: Update 0.0.23- Reworked progression of Harvest and Attack skills layout in Skill Tree.- Market Sell Speed can also be unlocked right after Portal.- Reduced the cost of Familiar Ranch Skill from 15k to 10k.- Increased the cost of Mana Restoration Amount skills.

events.title: Update 0.0.22
events.summary: Update 0.0.22- More Main Menu Visuals Updates.- More Ultra Wide support.- Fixed an issue with Inventory UI on lower resolutions.

events.title: Update 0.0.21
events.summary: Update 0.0.21- Polished up the Player Sprite.- Changed the Prestige Exp bar to Purple to match with the portal.- Show Stats by default(Turn Off with H)- Changed the names of the language selections to their own country names.- Fixed an issue where Language selection started on English instead of the actual language selected.

events.title: Update 0.0.20
events.summary: Update 0.0.20Remade the target indicators visuals.Added Localization.

events.title: Update 0.0.19
events.summary: Update 0.0.19- Default Skill Tree zoom out by about 30% (Developer Note: I've noticed people zoom out all the way anyways, let me know what you think)- Improvements to Tooltip in Skill Tree, will not show on left or right side.- Added visual effect to Prestige Exp and Prestige Leveling.- Added sound effects to bag opening/closing/interaction.- Added Interaction failed. (Developer Note: Let me know if its too much) - No items to add to market. - No gold to pick up. - No inventory space for items

events.title: Update 0.0.18
events.summary: Update 0.0.18- Refined the Tutorial a bit more(WIP).- Mana Star reworked(It's a pickup now, you have to interact with)(WIP).- Changed the audio sound for buttons hovered/pressed should be a bit less annoying sounds.- Added red outline and shake effect for health and mana when below 10 points(WIP).- Improved the gold pick up from gold chest.
